brief:
Palestinian medical sources reported that Israeli attacks killed three Palestinians on Monday, two in a drone strike near Yarmouk Stadium and another near the "Yellow Cubes" area in Al-Mawasi in Rafah, IMEMC News reported.

The strikes targeted different areas of the enclave, with the deadliest hitting the stadium vicinity in what appeared to be a concentrated operation. The remaining casualty occurred in the southern Rafah district.
dek: Palestinian medical sources reported that three Palestinians were killed in Monday’s attacks: two in a drone strike near Yarmouk Stadium and another near the “Yellow Cubes” area in Al-Mawasi in Rafah.
title: Israeli drone strike kills three Palestinians in Gaza
